question.text: The frequency $v$ of the radiation emitted by an atom when an electron jumps from one orbit to another is given by $=\mathrm{k} \delta \mathrm{E}$, where $\mathrm{k}$ is a constant and $\delta \mathrm{E}$ is the change in energy level due to the transition. Then dimension of $\mathrm{k}$ is

options.text: the same dimension of angular momentum

solution.text:
Hint: 
$v=k \delta E$
$[k]=\left[\frac{v}{\delta E}\right]=\frac{\left[T^{-1}\right]}{\left[M L^{2} T^{-2}\right]}$
$[k]=\left[M^{-} L^{-2} T^{1}\right]$
